raw.name: Pauper's Diadem
raw.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.
raw.flavor: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.

raw.name: Pearl of Sagacity
raw.textTemplate: +1 max Mana. Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
raw.flavor: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.

raw.name: Prismatic Thorn
raw.textTemplate: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).
raw.flavor: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.

raw.name: Pruning Hook
raw.textTemplate: Your deck may be 1 card smaller.
raw.flavor: Cut back the weak growth, and the rest bears fruit.

raw.name: Purse of Borrowed Shadows
raw.textTemplate: After your first explicit discard each turn, gain {block} Block.
raw.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

raw.name: Radiant Aegis
raw.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
raw.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.

raw.name: Restless Clasp
raw.textTemplate: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.
raw.flavor: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.

raw.name: Sacrificial Knife
raw.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
raw.flavor: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.

raw.name: Salted Relic
raw.textTemplate: Gain 20% more Cinders from combats.
raw.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.

raw.name: Scribe's Mirror
raw.textTemplate: When you pick this up, copy one card you own.
raw.flavor: It shows the page, and then it shows it again.

raw.name: Sealstone Key
raw.textTemplate: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.

raw.name: Sentinel's Oath
raw.textTemplate: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.

raw.name: Starstone Shard
raw.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.
raw.flavor: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.

raw.name: Threadbare Satchel
raw.textTemplate: Your deck may be 1 card smaller.
raw.flavor: It holds less than it used to. So do you.

raw.name: Titan's Cinder
raw.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.

raw.name: Traveler's Whetstone
raw.textTemplate: The first time you Stagger an enemy each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.

raw.name: Twinned Armour
raw.textTemplate: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.

raw.name: Vigilant Halo
raw.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy is Broken, heal {heal} HP.
raw.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.

raw.name: Vow of Vengeance
raw.textTemplate: The first time an enemy dies each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: Every name you take is a name you carry.

raw.name: Warden Horn
raw.textTemplate: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
raw.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.

raw.name: Warden's Lantern
raw.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
raw.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.

raw.name: Warhorn
raw.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: One long note, and the old anger answers.

raw.name: Watchman's Badge
raw.textTemplate: On your first turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
raw.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.

raw.name: Waxen Seal
raw.textTemplate: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.
raw.flavor: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.

raw.name: Wayfarer's Knot
raw.textTemplate: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.
raw.flavor: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.

raw.name: Whetstone Fragment
raw.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.

raw.name: Whetstone Pouch
raw.textTemplate: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
raw.flavor: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.

raw.name: Whisperglass Die
raw.textTemplate: If your first card in combat is a Blade attack, it deals +{chargeDamage} damage.
raw.flavor: A keepsake of the road through ash.

raw.name: Wrath Coil
raw.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
raw.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.

raw.name: Wyrm Heart
raw.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.
raw.flavor: It still beats. It expects something of you.

raw.name: Arbalest
raw.blurb: It takes a winch to span and a wall to stop it.

raw.name: Ash Staff
raw.blurb: Grey wood, warm at the grip.

raw.name: Ashen Claymore
raw.blurb: Cooled in ash, and it never quite cools.

raw.name: Battleaxe
raw.blurb: It was a woodcutter's once.

raw.name: Bearded Axe
raw.blurb: The long beard of the blade hooks what it cannot cut.

raw.name: Beast Claws
raw.blurb: Taken from something that no longer needs them.

raw.name: Blight Rod
raw.blurb: Wet to the touch. It should not be.

raw.name: Bone Sceptre
raw.blurb: Someone knelt for this once.

raw.name: Bone Talisman
raw.blurb: Knuckle and thread. It listens for the dead.

raw.name: Broadsword
raw.blurb: Wide of blade, and it clears a room.

raw.name: Buckler
raw.blurb: Small enough to be quick with.

raw.name: Cinder Axe
raw.blurb: A furnace edge bought with a slower swing.

raw.name: Dagger
raw.blurb: Two cuts where one would do.

raw.name: Duelist's Foil
raw.blurb: Light as a promise, and kept the same way.

raw.name: Dusk Chime
raw.blurb: Its last note settles into a sheltering hush.

raw.name: Emberlight Sceptre
raw.blurb: It keeps a little of the guiding flame.

raw.name: Estoc
raw.blurb: Stiff and four-edged, made to find the seam in plate.

raw.name: Flail
raw.blurb: The head has opinions about where it lands.

raw.name: Flamberge
raw.blurb: A flame-shaped blade that burns where it passes.

raw.name: Frost Spear
raw.blurb: A rimed point that slows the next advance.

raw.name: Goldbough Branch
raw.blurb: Cut, and still growing.

raw.name: Gorefire Brand
raw.blurb: Blood takes to flame more readily than wood.

raw.name: Greatsword
raw.blurb: Slow, and it does not care.

raw.name: Grimoire
raw.blurb: Margins crowded with someone else's fire.

raw.name: Halberd
raw.blurb: Reach enough to keep the dead at arm's length.

raw.name: Hand Crossbow
raw.blurb: Small, spanned in a breath, and not for show.

raw.name: Hunter's Recurve
raw.blurb: Curved to hold a draw all afternoon.

raw.name: Iron Knuckles
raw.blurb: Four rings of iron, and nothing between you and the argument.

raw.name: Katana
raw.blurb: A long curve, and a long grudge.

raw.name: Kite Shield
raw.blurb: A wall you can carry. Your arm knows it.

raw.name: Kris
raw.blurb: A wavering blade that leaves the wound open.

raw.name: Lantern
raw.blurb: Light enough to see what is coming.

raw.name: Leather Whip
raw.blurb: It cracks from a distance and is heard from further.

raw.name: Longbow
raw.blurb: Tall as its archer, and it reaches nearly as far.

raw.name: Mace
raw.blurb: Flanged iron and no subtlety at all.

raw.name: Maul
raw.blurb: Built to break a stance, not a skin.

raw.name: Moon Glaives
raw.blurb: Two crescents, and the cold follows both.

raw.name: Moonlit Katana
raw.blurb: Pale along the edge, and patient as the moon.

raw.name: Morning Star
raw.blurb: The spikes are what it has instead of mercy.

raw.name: Parrying Dagger
raw.blurb: Held wrong on purpose.

raw.name: Pike
raw.blurb: Long enough that the first blow is yours.

raw.name: Prayer Book
raw.blurb: Worn soft at the pages that were needed most.

raw.name: Rapier
raw.blurb: A duellist's point. It answers before you ask.

raw.name: Reaper's Crescent
raw.blurb: It takes a little back for every life it cuts.

raw.name: Round Shield
raw.blurb: Plain, round, and enough.

raw.name: Scythe
raw.blurb: A harvest tool, repurposed. The crop is the same.

raw.name: Shortbow
raw.blurb: A compact ash-wood bow bound for a quick draw.

raw.name: Spiked Shield
raw.blurb: Defence with an opinion.

raw.name: Starstone Staff
raw.blurb: The stone hums before you do.

raw.name: Stiletto
raw.blurb: Thin enough to find the gap in anything.

raw.name: Storm Sceptre
raw.blurb: It hums when the sky does.

raw.name: Straight Sword
raw.blurb: Honest steel. It asks nothing clever of you.

raw.name: Sun Talisman
raw.blurb: A small gold disc that remembers noon.

raw.name: Thorn Whip
raw.blurb: Barbed cord. It bites back at the hand.

raw.name: Thunder Mallet
raw.blurb: Every swing carries a little weather.

raw.name: Torch
raw.blurb: Fire remembers what steel forgets.

raw.name: Tower Shield
raw.blurb: You will not be moved. You will not move.

raw.name: Twinblade
raw.blurb: Both ends are the business end.

raw.name: Warhammer
raw.blurb: Poise is a fiction. This is the argument.

raw.name: Wyrmhorn Staff
raw.blurb: Taken from something that objected.

raw.name: Zweihander
raw.blurb: Two hands, a wide stance, and no apology.
